# Contract-v3 inter-field comb confirmation

Shift `s` means field-2 line `top2+s+i` sits between field-1 lines `top1+i` and `top1+i+1`. A 240-line geometry closure therefore expects shift zero. Flat, moving, and indecisive pairs are unmeasurable and carry no numeric shift.

Known pending census correction: SP field-2 units 87, 258, 439, and 467 have the tape's black line 22 at L286 (mean 3.8-6.0, standard deviation 3-4) and picture from L287, while this reference revision still reports top L286.
